name: Nevada

jury_list.statute: No NRS section in chapter 6 addresses public access to juror qualification records or creates a list of persons excused as non-citizens. NRS 6.010: a qualified juror is 'every qualified elector of the State, whether registered or not', with the other listed qualifications. NRS 6.090(2): after the sheriff returns the venire, 'the venire is subject to inspection by any officer or attorney of the court.' Status of records of non-citizen excusals: null.

sources.cite: NRS 6.045(3), (5) (list of qualified electors compiled from voter, DMV, DETR, public utility and DHHS lists; record of the name, occupation, address and race of each juror selected and each juror who appears)
NRS 6.090(2) (venire open to inspection by officers and attorneys of the court)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person, at the county clerk's office, for 1 cent per name (NRS 293.440(1)). Lists include address, date of birth, phone, and application serial number (293.440(2)), except fields withheld under 293.558.

sources.cite: NRS 293.558 (fields withheld: SSN, license number, email; address and phone on request)
NRS 293.503(3), (5) (county clerk's list-maintenance records, including names and addresses of persons mailed notices under 293.535, open for public inspection)

private_challenge.who: Any elector or other reliable person (NRS 293.535(1)).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: NRS 293.535(1)(a), (3): affidavit to the county clerk that the registrant is not a U.S. citizen. The clerk notifies the registrant by certified mail; the registration is cancelled unless the registrant shows proof of citizenship within 15 days. A separate written challenge by a voter of the same precinct is allowed from day 30 to day 25 (293.547).
private_challenge.deadlines: A citizenship affidavit must be filed no later than 30 days before an election (293.535(3)). Written challenges under 293.547: after day 30 and no later than day 25. Withdrawal no later than day 25 (293.548).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: The affiant must state that he or she has personal knowledge of the facts (293.535(1)). 293.547 challenges must also rest on personal knowledge and be signed and verified.

sources.cite: NRS 293.547 (written challenges; same precinct; personal knowledge; one name per challenge)

state_windows.effect: Must be filed no later than 30 days before an election.
Filed after day 30 and no later than day 25 before the election.

county_board.name: Nevada Secretary of State - county clerk contact information
county_board.note: Affidavits under NRS 293.535 go to the county clerk.

audit_path.statute: NRS 239.010 (public books and records) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county clerk: per year, the number of affidavits filed under NRS 293.535(1)(a) stating that a registrant is not a U.S. citizen, and the number of registrations cancelled under 293.535(3). NRS 293.503(3) and (5) make the clerk's list-maintenance records open for public inspection.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Nevada statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials, so there is no jury count to ask for.

gates.basis: Jury records: no NRS section opens or closes records of non-citizen excusals (null), so counts only. Nevada's citizenship affidavit needs personal knowledge (NRS 293.535(1)). Strict gates.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute, holder, source_url and sources filled from NRS chapter 6; voter_file source 293.503 added; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null. official_pipeline stays null. No voter_file behavior field changes.

PA-style check: no Nevada statute makes a list of persons excused as non-citizens public. The only inspection rule in chapter 6 is 6.090(2), and it covers the venire (persons summoned), for officers and attorneys of the court only.
official_pipeline is null: no section of NRS chapter 6 or chapter 293 sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. No 2025-26 Nevada bill to add one was found.

Jury source lists: NRS 6.045(3) draws on voter, DMV, DETR, public utility and DHHS lists, and 6.010 qualifies electors 'whether registered or not'. A Nevada juror record does not show that the person was registered to vote.

Cancelled-voter file: 293.503(3) and (5) make public the clerk's records of list-maintenance programs, including the names and addresses of persons mailed notices under 293.535. The statute lists no reason-code field; no jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.

juryroll_lead_sufficient is false: NRS 293.535(1) says 'The affiant must state that he or she has personal knowledge of the facts set forth in the affidavit.' 293.547(2)(b) also requires personal knowledge. A data match is not personal knowledge.
registration_date_in_public_file is null: 293.440(2) requires 'the date of the most recent addition or revision to an entry', which is not always the registration date.
permitted_uses is null: 293.440(1) lets 'Any person' get a copy for 1 cent per name and states no use limit. No other use limit was confirmed.
one_per_affidavit is null for 293.535; it is true for 293.547 challenges ('must not contain the name of more than one person', 293.547(4)).
Source note: NRS chapters 6, 239 and 293 read on leg.state.nv.us on 2026-10-07. The text of NRS 239.005 was not checked, so whether chapter 239 reaches court jury records is unknown.
